name: seo-console-mcp
description: Search Console, Google Ads, App Store, Google Play, WordPress.org and Core Web Vitals over MCP
long_description: Search analytics, striking-distance keywords, CTR gaps, cannibalization, indexing coverage, PageSpeed and on-page audits, App Store and Google Play listings and stats, WordPress.org plugin stats, real-user Core Web Vitals, Google Ads reads with guarded writes, and timestamped snapshots you can diff. Every setting is optional: the HTML audit, PageSpeed, IndexNow, keyword ideas and WordPress.org tools work with none of them, and each other tool says which setting it needs when it is missing.

credentials.title: Google service account key
credentials.description: JSON key of a service account added as a user on your Search Console properties. Needed by the Search Console tools and snapshot.

pagespeed_key.title: PageSpeed Insights API key
pagespeed_key.description: Raises the small anonymous PageSpeed quota. Also used for the Chrome UX Report when no separate key is set.

crux_key.title: Chrome UX Report API key
crux_key.description: For crux_field_data and crux_history, if your PageSpeed key is not allowed to call the Chrome UX Report API.

indexnow_key.title: IndexNow key
indexnow_key.description: Default key for indexnow_submit. The same key must be hosted on the site at https://<host>/<key>.txt.

play_bucket.title: Google Play reports bucket
play_bucket.description: The pubsite_prod_... bucket named in Play Console under Download reports. Needed by play_store_stats.

play_credentials.title: Google Play service account key
play_credentials.description: Only if Play reports should be read with a different service account from the one above.

asc_key_path.title: App Store Connect private key (.p8)
asc_key_path.description: Needed by the App Store tools.

asc_key_id.title: App Store Connect key ID
asc_key_id.description: The ID shown beside the key in App Store Connect.

asc_issuer_id.title: App Store Connect issuer ID
asc_issuer_id.description: For a team key. Individual keys have no issuer ID.

asc_vendor_number.title: App Store vendor number
asc_vendor_number.description: Needed by app_store_sales. Shown in App Store Connect under Payments and Financial Reports.

ads_developer_token.title: Google Ads developer token
ads_developer_token.description: Needed by the Google Ads tools, with the OAuth client, refresh token and customer ID below.

ads_client_id.title: Google Ads OAuth client ID
ads_client_id.description: OAuth client used to mint Google Ads access tokens.

ads_client_secret.title: Google Ads OAuth client secret
ads_client_secret.description: Secret of the OAuth client above.

ads_refresh_token.title: Google Ads refresh token
ads_refresh_token.description: Refresh token issued to that OAuth client for the Ads account.

ads_customer_id.title: Google Ads customer ID
ads_customer_id.description: The account number, with or without dashes.

snapshot_dir.title: Snapshot directory
snapshot_dir.description: Where snapshot documents are written and read. Defaults to ~/.config/seo-mcp/snapshots.
